title: VIVO Height Adjustable 32 inch Standing Desk Converter with Dual 13 to 30 inch Monitor Stand, Sit Stand Monitor Mount and Desk Riser, Gray, DESK-V000K-M2G

reviews.title: The monitor arm mounts are a game changer!
reviews.body: I never leave reviews but I had to for this standing desk converter. This has been exactly what I've been looking for and I'm so glad I stumbled upon this! I have a very short desk (in depth) so I often found myself having to hunch over to use the keyboard and mouse. I've looked for anything to "extend" my desk but I also have a drawer directly underneath so I was not able to clamp anything to front or the back due to the way it's constructed. This standing desk is the PERFECT size for my unorthodox desk! Even though the keyboard tray hangs over the desk, it's not an issue for me and actually is exactly what I needed.The assembly was pretty easy and the instructions were clear. The attached monitor stand is GENIUS! I was able to skip the monitor arms part as I had a VIVO freestanding dual monitor stand already, so I just plopped the arms from that one with the monitors on it onto this one and it fit like a glove! The build is top notch and does not feel flimsy or cheap in any way. It's able to lock at any point and moving it up and down is smooth like butter. It is heavy in weight which is a good thing so you know it's not made cheaply. The price may seem high but it's pretty in line with other standing desk converters and with the added monitor arm mounts, it's 100% even more worth it.If you're looking for a standing desk alternative without replacing your entire desk, this is the product for you! If the keyboard tray was able to slide in & out, it would be absolutely perfect but I am still not complaining with how it is now. Best purchase in a long while!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 11, 2025
reviews.author: Louis B

reviews.title: Great Value Standing Desk That Checks All the Boxes
reviews.body: I have been thinking about getting a standing desk for a while, but I always felt they were overpriced—until I found this beauty. It’s perfect for mounting my dual 27” monitors and adjusts easily to fit my 5'9" frame. The desk is sturdy and well-made, and the wood color is exactly what I was looking for—it fits beautifully in my office.One feature I really appreciate is the removable monitor stand. It gives you flexibility to change your setup if needed, which is a big plus for me. You never know when you might want to reconfigure your space.If I had to point out one downside, it would be that the keyboard tray doesn’t slide in and out. That said, the fixed design hasn’t been an issue at all—it still meets all my needs and then some.

reviews.title: Amazing standing desk
reviews.body: I received this desk really quickly.  The directions were not very clear and I was missing a couple screws but had many extra screws in the other sizes.  Assembly took approximately 1 hour with one person.  The sit to stand desk is very sturdy and works amazing.  The hydraulic lift makes changing positions from sitting to standing very easy.  I would definitely recommend.  The only issue I had with assembly was the screws for the monitors were difficult to attach to the monitors but I was able to make it work.

reviews.author: Kristy Harrington

reviews.title: Love This!
reviews.body: This standing desk riser was the perfect solution to continue using my antique, three-legged table and still have a standing desk. My monitor stands we're not the same height before and now, I finally have monitors the same height. Having the monitors mounted to the table makes it very secure, stable and easy to rise and lower the stand. Since it raises with a hydraulic system, you don't have any of the concerns that would come with an electrical system. The keyboard tray jets out to the perfect distance for me to sit under it, without needing my table open. It was easy to put together, but I did need help to lift it onto the table and get the monitors attached at the right height. I love using this standing riser, it has greatly helped my hip, back and neck. It is well made, came with all the tools and screws needed and easy instructions. I highly recommend it!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 15, 2023
reviews.author: Karen Cressman

reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.body: This thing was great when I first got it, but after 6 months or so, it started becoming very difficult to lift. When I contacted support, they walked me through how to adjust the gas spring. That didn’t work, but I figured I’d just deal with it. 2 years after I bought it, it was finally completely stuck. I contacted customer service again, and much to my surprise, they provided a new gas spring free of charge. Shipping and all! Two years after I bought the thing! The product is good, but the customer service is great. I would absolutely buy from them again!

features: 32" Desk Riser with Dual Monitor Mount: Elevate your productivity and comfortable viewing angles with this desktop riser and dual monitor mount! The stand fits two 13” to 30” screens up to 17.6 lbs each with VESA 75x75mm or 100x100mm patterns --Patented--

Height Adjustable Desktop: Go from sitting to standing in one smooth motion using the innovative height lock mechanism (Adjustment Range: 4.5” to 20”). The top surface measures 31.5” x 15.7” and the keyboard tray measures 31.3” x 11.8” (10.5" in center)

Full Motion Stand: The monitor mount offers +45° to -45° tilt, 180° swivel, 360° rotation, abd height adjustment along the center pole. Monitors can be placed in portrait or landscape orientation and are held securely with a heavy-duty grommet mount
Very Minimal Assembly: Simply attach the keyboard tray to the riser and monitor arms to the stand, mount the stand to the riser, and install your screens with the removable VESA plates

Solid Steel Frame: Designed for scratch resistance and durability, sturdy steel support will keep your devices safe and secure. Underside padding is provided to protect your desk surface from scuffs and scratches
